ai.summary: Karnataka High Court struck down state law increasing reservations beyond constitutional 50% cap, while J&K's reservation policy reached 70% amid political tensions.

facts.claim: Karnataka High Court struck down state law increasing reservations beyond constitutional 50% cap
facts.quote: A Bench of the Karnataka High Court, headed by Chief Justice Vibhu Bakhru, declared Sections 3 and 4 of the Karnataka Scheduled Castes and Scheduled Tribes (Reservation of Seats in Educational Institutions and of Appointments or Posts in the Services under the State) Act, 2022, unconstitutional.

facts.claim: J&K's reservation policy reached 70% amid political tensions
facts.quote: In Jammu and Kashmir, the reservation issue has become explosive and combustible. In the opinion of many people, it has been weaponised to empower some categories while disempowering others.

ai.background_note: Karnataka High Court ruled state reservations for SCs and STs exceeded constitutional 50% cap, while J&K's reservation policy reached 70% after political changes.
